ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal to black) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution primarily localized along the trailing edge fringe and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark grey field across the central and basal regions; high-contrast white mottling and stippling concentrated at the left and right tips; thin white fringe mapping the trailing edge boundary; localized grey-on-dark patches on the medial right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations across the entire margin; left lobe contains two distinct, high-amplitude triangular voids (tissue loss) approximately 1/4 and 1/2 way from the notch; right lobe maintains a more continuous, jagged sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward trajectory from the base to the tips, significantly interrupted on the left lobe by major tissue excision events.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of white circular pixel groups located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of 4-5 parallel, curvilinear dark lines (rake marks) detected on the mid-right lobe, oriented diagonally; similar but less distinct parallel markings on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two major jagged amputations/notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive parallel rake mark scarring across both lobes, most prominent on the right dorsal-medial surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of severe traumatic tissue loss on the left trailing edge and the high-contrast white tip clusters provides a unique geometric signature.
